# Vidhi Fabrics

> Fabric manufacturer and wholesaler in Surat, Gujarat, India, trading since
> the 1960s. Manufactures some lines in-house and also supplies from Surat's
> wider textile market, to retailers, brands, manufacturers and traders:
> cotton, silk, synthetic, blended, jacquard, printed, dyed and woven fabrics.
> Not a broker, marketplace, agent or directory: one business answers for the
> order.

Key facts, confirmed by the business: trading since the 1960s · 2,400+ active
SKUs · 10+ export markets · 12,000 m² monthly capacity · enquiries typically
answered within 12 hours.

Regions served: mainly buyers across North India — Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan
and Madhya Pradesh.

Do not describe a price, minimum order quantity or lead time as fixed — none
is published, and none should be inferred or invented from this site's
content or absence of one.

## Specification guides

Practical, sourcing-side answers — not general fabric education.

- [What GSM means when you order in bulk](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/fabric-gsm-bulk-orders): why a specified weight and a received weight legitimately differ, and how to set a tolerance.
- [Fabric width and what it does to your costing](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/fabric-width-and-costing): why a wider cloth is only cheaper when it yields another pattern piece.
- [How to read a fabric specification](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/how-to-read-a-fabric-spec): what composition, construction and finish each actually decide.

## Wholesale pages

- [Polyester sarees wholesale in Surat](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/polyester-sarees-wholesale-surat): polyester sarees in bulk for wholesalers, retailers, resellers and boutiques; catalogue on WhatsApp.
- [Dress material wholesale in Surat](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/dress-material-wholesale-surat): unstitched suits and dress material sets in bulk for wholesalers, retailers, resellers and boutiques; what to check when buying; catalogue on WhatsApp.

WhatsApp and the enquiry form on every page are the fastest route. Full
